snippet.title: Trailer Olive Raiders
snippet.description:
🎬 The Trailer Has Arrived – And the Ride Is Just Beginning 🎬

Dust, zeppelin, and destiny — the official trailer for our Spaghetti Western set in the untamed South of Italy is finally out.
Get your first look at Veronica, Aloisio, Totonno, Francesco… and the smoke-filled world they’re ready to tear apart.

But we’re not stopping here.
We’re working hard behind the scenes to bring the game to Steam and launch our Kickstarter campaign soon. Your support can help turn this wild vision into a full-blown legend.

🤠 Saddle up. The frontier needs guns, gold, and guts.

📝 Wishlist soon on Steam – Kickstarter page loading...

#SpaghettiWestern #GameTrailer #KickstarterComingSoon #SteamWishlist #IndieGame #WildSouth #WesternGame #BountyAndBullet #GameDev

💥 Tagline:
"It started with a bounty. It became a war."
